args.body:
Dear Customer,

Your request for a refund of €175 has been processed successfully. This refund covers the incorrect seat charge applied to your account, which has now been corrected to **25 seats**.

**Refund Details:**
- Amount: €175
- Reason: Overcharge due to incorrect seat allocation
- Processing Time: ~3-5 business days

**Next Steps:**
Please confirm the receipt of this refund adjustment by replying to this email. Should you have any further questions, our support team is available.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
